facts.reason: Candidate poses satisfy the zone test. The lab cannot adjudicate a release.

facts.statement: Active HUB credit requires the FUEL to pass the opening and the sensor. Processing can continue briefly at timing boundaries.
facts.reason: A delivered piece is an opportunity; no flight, sensor lag or referee call is simulated.

facts.statement: The AUTO FUEL leader starts inactive in shift 1. FMS resolves ties. Both HUBs are active in AUTO, transition and end game.
facts.reason: Select one schedule branch per alliance; the lab does not simulate AUTO results.

facts.statement: TOWER level 1 in AUTO earns 15 points, capped at two robots per alliance. TELEOP levels 1–3 earn 10, 20 or 30 points per robot.
facts.reason: Students should value the displaced scoring window and climbing reliability before pursuing this separate role.

facts.statement: Ranking points include alliance FUEL and TOWER performance incentives.
facts.reason: Compare an alliance-level objective separately from a single robot's nominal opportunity.

facts.statement: HUBs return FUEL into neutral space. Directly catching freshly discharged FUEL is restricted.
facts.reason: Choose supply arrivals explicitly. Neither ownership nor immediate recycling is guaranteed.

facts.statement: Bumpers overlap the starting line, the robot avoids BUMP contact and onboard preload is limited.
facts.reason: Recheck each edited start configuration; the rehearsal does not inspect staging legality.

facts.statement: Opposing robot contact during AUTO is restricted on the opponent side of the centerline.
facts.reason: Traffic is a routing cue, not permission for contact.

facts.statement: Mass, single-side horizontal extension and vertical limits constrain later mechanisms.
facts.reason: Moving mechanisms and mass are outside this initial box study.

facts.statement: Kickoff notes identify revisions to bumper coverage, construction, fastening relative to the frame and team-number coverage.
facts.reason: Bumper thickness is a project scenario assumption. Later technical design needs an explicit compliance check.
